style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun
motion_rule: he never stops: sprinting on long legs to 4.9, then flying low down the corridor, the camera beside him at his height so the money walls tear past every beat; loose notes wipe the lens every beat; he fills half the frame height, chest up from 7.2; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the notes fly to him; no push in, no rack focus
character: a tall pink flamingo in a grey banker waistcoat, long black beak, deadpan face
second_characters: ONE lean flamingo teller in a green visor sprinting at the lens all clip, flinging notes
props: two notes of the same size and colour the teller flings, a huge 100 printed across each, a $ on the first and a ruble sign ₽ on the second, a gale of loose notes gusting past his legs
prop_continuity: the notes fly until his beak takes them; the 100 and the ₽ stay readable on the ruble note; it stays limp and shaggy from 5.6; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a narrow corridor, bricks of banknotes filling both walls to the ceiling, violet then green then blue, a paper gale

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.1 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: bank-NO-ty, o-di-NA-ko-vy-e, ha-RAK-ter, u fto-ROY, MYAG-che
audio.pacing: 0.0-2.2 one breath; pause 2.2-6.4; 6.4-8.4 one breath; after 8.4 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his beak opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: footfalls to 4.9 then wingbeats, paper storm, a sheet metal ring at 2.4, a squelch at 4.4, a scrubbing rustle 5.6-6.4, a roll unspooling at 8.4

timeline.a: he bursts into frame at a full run past violet bricks and the teller sprinting beside him thrusts both notes at the lens, a 100 and a $ on one, a 100 and a ₽ on the other
the teller flicks both notes spinning side by side across the frame, the same 100 flashing on both, and he runs on under them past green bricks
he snaps the dollar note out of the air in his beak at a full run and it stays board stiff, ringing like sheet metal, ricocheting past the lens
the teller flings the ruble note in spinning, the 100 and the ₽ on it, tearing past blue bricks
he snaps the ruble note the same way mid-run and his beak sinks straight through it, the paper going limp
he throws his wings open into low flight and catches the limp note off his beak between both feet, the bricks tearing past under him
close on both feet in flight, scrubbing the note back and forth the way you soften a sheet of newspaper, the 100 and the ₽ crumpling shaggy and fluffy as toilet paper, walls streaking behind
he shakes the shaggy note at the lens in flight, the 100 and the ₽ still readable on it
chest-up, face to camera, still flying, the fluffed note hanging off one foot as the walls streak behind
the note unspools off his foot into a ribbon of toilet paper printed over and over with 100 ₽, whipping past the lens
he flies on, the ribbon streaming after him, the teller swept aside

must_appear: a huge 100 on both notes, a $ on the first and a ₽ on the second; at 4.4 his beak sinks through the ruble note and it goes limp; from 5.6 both feet scrub it close in frame until it is fluffy as toilet paper; at 8.4 it unspools into a ribbon printed over and over with 100 ₽
negative_prompt: speech bubble, speech balloon, comic panel, subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a still background, a hero sitting, a hero riding, a hero standing to work on a prop, a wide or distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, human hands, cyrillic letters, speech after 8.4
